trigger_if: Any sealed v0.11.1 package integrity check fails after promotion.
Any frozen v0.11.1 registry artifact is found mutated.
Any protected v0.10/earlier or failed-v0.11 baseline byte is found mutated.
Any v0.11.1 mandatory gate is later shown to have been bypassed.
Independent verification evidence is shown not to correspond to the sealed VERIFYING source checkpoint.
rollback_rule: Preserve all v0.11 and v0.11.1 evidence; restore executable authority to sealed v0.10 without rewriting failed or frozen history.
